notes.title: New Update: Version 4.2.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Update: Version 4.2.0[/b]

[b]Barracks Overhaul:[/b]
You can now select weapons and view the weapon model along with its skin. Rotate the model for a closer inspection and more detailed look.

[b]Server Improvements:[/b]
Optimizations have been made on the server side for better performance and stability.

[b]Weapon Recoil & Spray Adjustments:[/b]
Significant reduction in recoil and spray, providing more precision while moving, but still maintaining competitive integrity (standing still remains optimal for accuracy).

[b]Group System Overhaul:[/b]
The group system has been improved for smoother handling when joining a group. A new button has been added to easily copy and share the group code.

[b]Matchmaking Update:[/b]
During the Alpha/Beta phases, Competitive Ranks will no longer influence matchmaking.

[b]Player Card Fix in Barracks:[/b]
A bug causing incorrect rank display has been fixed.

[b]Competitive Mode Fix (Search and Destroy):[/b]
A bug that caused the bomb to explode when the defending team was fully eliminated (without the bomb being planted) has been fixed. Attacker teams now no longer earn double points for eliminating defenders and bomb explosion.

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]
- Player portraits for both teams are now visible at the top of the screen. Dead players' portraits will show with an "X".
- Displays now indicate if a player has connection issues or leaves the game, resulting in penalties.

[b]Team Colors Update:[/b]
Attackers and Defenders no longer have fixed colors (Red and Blue). The colors now reflect team affiliation:
- [b]Red[/b] is always the enemy.
- [b]Blue[/b] is your team (friendly).
- We're considering whether Attackers and Defenders should get their own distinct colors or if Red will always be the enemy and Blue the friendly team.

[b]Exit Button in Main Menu:[/b]
A new [b]X[/b] button has been added in the top corner of the main menu, allowing players to exit the game before connecting to the master server, even before pressing "Authenticate".

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.6.0
notes.notes:
**New Update: Version 2.7.0**

[b]Profile Redesign:[/b]
  - Profiles in the main menu now feature a revamped design. Additionally, the last rounds played by a player are now displayed. The Last Rounds section shows whether a player won, lost, or drew the round, along with their kill count, death count, map, and game mode.

[b]Settings Overhaul:[/b]
  - Settings have been revamped for improved functionality and user experience.

[b]Network Sound Fix:[/b]
  - Fixed an issue where some players' shots were not audible over the network at certain points.

[b]Player Animation Synchronization:[/b]
  - Addressed an issue where player animations were not synchronized properly over the network at certain points.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.5.0
notes.notes:
Search & Destroy:
[list]
[*] Added a 30-second warm-up phase to Search & Destroy. 
After each round, there will be 30 seconds of warm-up followed by a 2-minute timer until the attackers plant the bomb or the defending team is eliminated. 
If the attackers are eliminated and the bomb has been planted, the defending team must defuse the bomb. Failure to do so results in victory for the attackers.
[*] During the warm-up, a large wall exists in each spawn area to allow teams to strategize defense and attack tactics.
[/list]
Main Menu:
[list]
[*] Added an Invitation Button in the main menu. If a friend has a code, you can use it to join their room.
[/list]

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.3.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]Player HUD Revamp:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The player HUD has been redesigned.
[*] The health bar is no longer a slider but displays your health precisely in text.
[*] Kill combo notifications (first kills, second kill, etc., up to headshot) now have a new appearance to match the updated HUD design.
[/list]

[u][b]Harbor Havoc Map Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Harbor Havoc map has been adjusted.
[*] Weather conditions have been made slightly darker with rain to create a more atmospheric ambiance.
[/list]
These updates bring improvements to the player HUD and enhance the atmosphere of the Harbor Havoc map. Enjoy the enhanced gaming experience! If you have any feedback or encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to let us know.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.2.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]Search & Destroy Round End Fix:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Corrected the round ending in Search & Destroy to ensure that the round now ends after completing 12 rounds as originally intended.
[/list]
[u][b]Timer Reset after Round Actions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The timer is now reset only after the round is restarted following bomb defusal, planting, or expiration. Previously, the timer was immediately reset and counted down before the round was restarted.
[/list]
[u][b]Background Round Tracking:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Each round is now stored in the background, including the winning and losing teams. This provides a better overview of which team won or lost each round, visible in the UI.
[/list]
[u][b]Main Menu UI Overhaul:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The UI in the main menu under "Multiplayer" has been revamped. Separate buttons for "Ranked" and "Unranked" for Search & Destroy have been added to better distinguish between game modes.
[/list]
[u][b]Search for Free Lobbies:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Lobby search now looks for free, unstarted rooms. If no rooms are found, a room for Ranked or Unranked is automatically created.
[/list]
[u][b]Separate Buttons for Other Game Modes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Separate buttons for Team Deathmatch (Unranked), FFA, and Last Man Standing (Unranked) have been added to facilitate room creation for these game modes.
[/list]
[u][b]QuickMatch for Unranked Games:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The QuickMatch button now only searches for Unranked games. For a Ranked game, the corresponding "Ranked" button must be pressed.
[/list]
[u][b]Stability Fixes and Harbor Havoc Glitch Corrections:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Several stability fixes have been implemented, including corrections for glitches in Harbor Havoc that caused players to be ejected from the map due to specific exploits.
[/list]
[u][b]Server-Side Stability Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Significant stability improvements have been made on the server side to enhance overall gameplay experience.
[/list]
[u][b]Red Rusty AKM Skin Adjustment:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Red Rusty AKM skin, which occasionally experienced issues with infinite ammo, has been rectified. (Note: The fix addresses an occasional issue where the Red Rusty AKM skin erroneously granted unlimited ammunition.)
[/list]
These updates not only address gameplay enhancements and stability fixes but also ensure a smoother overall experience for players. If further adjustments are desired or questions arise, feel free to reach out.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Update: Version 2.1.0[/b]

- [b]Removed Takeaway Animation[/b]:
  - The takeaway animation for all weapons has been removed to enable faster weapon switching.

- [b]Spray Control Adjustment[/b]:
  - The spray control of weapons while shooting has been slightly reworked to ensure improved accuracy.

- [b]Faster Weapon Switching[/b]:
  - Weapons can now be switched much faster by pressing keys 1, 2, 3, or 4, or using the scroll wheel.

- [b]Changes to Combat Knife[/b]:
  - The Combat Knife now deals 30 damage on the first hit and 38 damage on the second hit to increase its effectiveness.

- [b]Player Mobility Adjustments[/b]:
  - Player mobility has been adjusted to allow for better maneuverability. Hiding, peeking, and re-hiding around corners now occur more quickly and smoothly.

- [b]No Delay in Jumping[/b]:
  - Players can now jump consecutively without delay. However, movement will slow down after multiple jumps, without any delay between them.

- [b]MP5 Damage Adjustment[/b]:
  - Damage for the MP5 has been changed from 25 to 29.

- [b]Static Crosshair[/b]:
  - The crosshair is now static. Work is currently underway on the UI to allow players to customize the crosshair to their liking.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Update: Version 2.0.0[/b]

[u]Search & Destroy Adjustments:[/u]
- Disarming under the bridge no longer possible: Players can no longer disarm the bomb under the bridge, increasing the tactical depth and strategic value of positioning.
- Disarming or planting interrupted: Disarming or planting the bomb will be interrupted if the player dies during the process, ensuring a fair and balanced gameplay experience.

[u]Barracks Adjustments:[/u]
- New Layout: Banners and inventory are now located in the Barracks area, simplifying navigation and organization for players.

[u]Major Change: Weapon Spray Patterns:[/u]
- Fixed spray patterns: Adjusted weapon shooting behavior to have fixed spray patterns, aligning gameplay more towards competitive aspects and reducing luck factor.
